family_reports.body: Took sole legal custody-and now 50/50. 5 years in court -filed full custody 3x as punishment- his atty hired used/paid psychologists to say things that they routinely work with - said he wouldn’t stop until I have no custody left- I had 300+ pieces of evidence & testimony that was ignored and his behavior dismissed.

I asked for a divorce so that I could get at least half of my house or half of my children or half of my 401(k) or half of my car or half of my motorcycle instead they took everything now I’m homeless carless I work at 9 to 5 and I haven’t seen my kids since I met Mr. Whitbeck.
This corrupt system has destroyed us as a family unit and human beings. We have been demoralized and tormented in the most inhumane ways and will never be the same again.
